title_en: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-Live-1.1 语音代理模型，待机成本降至 $0.02/分钟
summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1, a full-duplex speech model for multilingual conversations, available via API as `gpt-live-1.1`. It improves accent consistency, transcription accuracy, letter/number handling, and task completion over GPT-Live-1, though no benchmark scores were published. The model supports a 128K-token context window and runs only on OpenAI's cloud via WebRTC or WebSocket. A new standby billing state cuts idle WebRTC time to $0.02 per minute (60% lower than the $0.05 active rate), with configurable idle timeout from 5 to 60 seconds. Backend reasoning and tool usage are billed separately.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布了 GPT-Live-1.1，这是一个全双工语音模型，支持多语言对话，可通过 API 以 `gpt-live-1.1` 调用。相比 GPT-Live-1，它在口音一致性、转录准确性、字母和数字处理以及任务完成可靠性方面有所提升，但未公布基准测试分数。该模型支持 128K token 的默认上下文窗口，仅通过 WebRTC 或 WebSocket 在 OpenAI 云上运行。新增的待机计费状态将空闲 WebRTC 时间降至每分钟 $0.02（比活跃状态的 $0.05 低 60%），空闲超时可配置为 5 到 60 秒。后端推理和工具使用单独计费。
content_en:
OpenAI has made GPT-Live-1.1 available in its API under the model ID `gpt-live-1.1`. The GPT-Live-1.1 voice model is a full-duplex model for multilingual conversations. It can listen while it speaks. OpenAI team states that it speaks with more natural and consistent accents across languages and completes tasks more reliably. The release also adds standby, a cheaper billing state for idle sessions. For teams running voice agents, idle time on a call now costs less. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** Live sessions hold a 128,000-token default context window.
- **Runs on:** OpenAI’s cloud only, via `v1/live/sessions`. Clients connect over WebRTC or WebSocket. No open weights, no quantized variants.
- **Performance:** OpenAI claims better accents, transcription, letter and number handling, and task completion than GPT-Live-1. No scores published.
- **Best:** Standby bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute versus $0.05 active, a 60% lower rate.
- **Worst:** OpenAI published 0 benchmark scores for 1.1. Image, video and structured outputs are not supported.
- **Bottom line:** Best: cheaper always-on voice sessions. Worst: quality gains are self-reported with no numbers.

## **What is GPT-Live-1.1?**

GPT-Live-1.1 is a full-duplex speech model from OpenAI that hears and speaks in 1 stream. It follows GPT-Live-1, which reached the API on September 10, 2026. As per the OpenAI forum announcement, it has powered ChatGPT Plus and Pro voice since October 15.

Inputs and outputs are audio and text. Image and video are not supported. Streaming and function calling work. Structured outputs, fine-tuning and predicted outputs do not.

## **How does GPT-Live-1.1 work?**

The GPT-Live family replaces the usual cascade of speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech. OpenAI says the model reasons over incoming and outgoing audio together in a single model. It also handles turn detection and returns ASR transcripts natively.

Deeper work is delegated. The voice model can hand reasoning and tool calls to a backend text model. OpenAI names GPT-6 Astra for complex issues and Luna for high-volume tasks. Third-party backends also work.

The Live conversations guide sets `delegation.type` to `client` or `responses`. Responses mode uses OpenAI models. Client mode connects your own backend. Instructions can run up to 16,384 tokens.

## **What changed from GPT-Live-1?**

**OpenAI lists 4 improvement areas for 1.1:**

- More natural and consistent accents across languages
- More accurate speech transcription
- Better handling of precise details like letters and numbers
- More reliable instruction following and task completion

## **How does standby mode work?**

Standby pauses inference during silence while the WebRTC connection stays open. **The guide documents 3 settings:**

- `session.wake_policy.type`: set to `speech`, so inference waits for speech
- `session.idle_timeout_s`: a whole number from 5 to 60 seconds
- `session.wake_policy.vad_threshold`: optional, 0 to 1, default 0.5

After the timeout, the server emits `session.paused`. When the user speaks, `session.resumed` fires. The session ID and history are kept. OpenAI warns the first reply after a short utterance may be slower. Keep the microphone track active during standby.

Standby works for both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1.

## **How much does GPT-Live-1.1 cost?**

| Session state | Price per minute | Price per hour | 
|---|---|---|
| Active | $0.05 | $3.00 | 
| Standby (WebRTC, inference paused) | $0.02 | $1.20 | 

Voice sessions are billed by duration. The GPT-Live-1 model page says billing is per second. Backend model and tool usage are billed separately. That matters: a heavy backend can cost more than the voice layer.

## **Deployment and availability**

The model is API-only. You switch an existing Live session by setting `model` to `gpt-live-1.1`. Changing the model requires a new session.

Outbound SIP calling reached all organizations on November 2, so phone agents are supported. GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1 have separate concurrent-session limits. Each limit applies across inference regions. The 1.1 page does not publish tier numbers.

## **How does GPT-Live-1.1 compare?**

| Feature | GPT-Live-1.1 | GPT-Live-1 | GPT-Realtime-2.1 | Gemini 3.8 Live | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | OpenAI | OpenAI | OpenAI |  | 
| Parameters | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 
| Input | Audio, text | Audio, text | Text, audio, image | Text, image, audio | 
| Output | Audio, text | Audio, text | Text, audio | Text, audio | 
| Context | 128K default (guide) | 128K default (guide) | 128K, 32K max output | 131,072 in, 65,536 out | 
| Pricing | $0.05/min active, $0.02/min standby | $0.05/min active, $0.02/min standby | $32 / $64 per 1M audio tokens (in/out) | Token-based (pricing) | 
| Idle standby billing | Yes (WebRTC) | Yes (WebRTC) | Not documented | Not documented | 
| Reasoning | Delegated to backend model | Delegated to backend model | Built in, configurable effort | Interleaved reasoning | 
| Function calling | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 
| Structured outputs | No | No | Not disclosed | No | 
| Published benchmarks | None for 1.1 | Full Duplex Bench +30 pts vs GPT-Realtime-2.1 | Baseline in that eval | Not compared | 
| License / weights | Closed, API only | Closed, API only | Closed, API only | Closed, API only | 

## **Key Takeaways**

- GPT-Live-1.1 is live in the API as `gpt-live-1.1`.
- Standby cuts idle WebRTC billing from $0.05 to $0.02 per minute.
- Idle timeout is configurable from 5 to 60 seconds.
- Accent, transcription and task gains are self-reported, with no scores.
- Backend reasoning and tools are billed separately from voice minutes.

Check out the model page, the Live conversations guide and the announcement. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

content_zh:
OpenAI 已在其 API 中以模型 ID `gpt-live-1.1` 提供 GPT-Live-1.1。GPT-Live-1.1 语音模型是一个用于多语言对话的全双工模型。它可以在说话的同时聆听。OpenAI 团队表示，它在不同语言中的口音更加自然和一致，并且能更可靠地完成任务。此次发布还新增了 standby，这是一种针对空闲会话的更便宜计费状态。对于运行语音代理的团队来说，通话中的空闲时间现在成本更低。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension** 查看部署选项和规格。

## **要点速览**

- **规模：** Live 会话默认持有 128,000 token 的上下文窗口。
- **运行于：** 仅限 OpenAI 云，通过 `v1/live/sessions`。客户端通过 WebRTC 或 WebSocket 连接。没有开放权重，没有量化变体。
- **性能：** OpenAI 声称其在口音、转录、字母和数字处理以及任务完成方面优于 GPT-Live-1。未公布分数。
- **最佳：** Standby 对空闲 WebRTC 时间按每分钟 $0.02 计费，而活跃时间为 $0.05，费率低 60%。
- **最差：** OpenAI 为 1.1 公布的基准分数为 0。不支持图像、视频和结构化输出。
- **底线：** 最佳：更便宜的常开语音会话。最差：质量提升为自述，没有数字。

## **什么是 GPT-Live-1.1？**

GPT-Live-1.1 是 OpenAI 的全双工语音模型，可在 1 个流中听和说。它接续 GPT-Live-1，后者于 2026 年 9 月 10 日进入 API。根据 OpenAI 论坛公告，它自 10 月 15 日起为 ChatGPT Plus 和 Pro 语音提供支持。

输入和输出为音频和文本。不支持图像和视频。流式和函数调用可用。结构化输出、微调和预测输出不可用。

## **GPT-Live-1.1 如何工作？**

GPT-Live 系列取代了通常的语音转文本、LLM 和文本转语音的级联。OpenAI 表示，该模型在单个模型中对传入和传出音频一起进行推理。它还处理轮次检测，并原生返回 ASR 转录。

更深层的工作被委托出去。语音模型可以将推理和工具调用交给后端文本模型。OpenAI 指定 GPT-6 Astra 用于复杂问题，Luna 用于高容量任务。第三方后端也可用。

Live 对话指南将 `delegation.type` 设置为 `client` 或 `responses`。Responses 模式使用 OpenAI 模型。Client 模式连接你自己的后端。指令最多可运行 16,384 token。

## **与 GPT-Live-1 相比有何变化？**

**OpenAI 列出了 1.1 的 4 个改进领域：**

- 跨语言更自然和一致的口音
- 更准确的语音转录
- 更好地处理字母和数字等精确细节
- 更可靠的指令遵循和任务完成

## **standby 模式如何工作？**

Standby 在静音期间暂停推理，同时 WebRTC 连接保持打开。**指南记录了 3 项设置：**

- `session.wake_policy.type`：设置为 `speech`，因此推理等待语音
- `session.idle_timeout_s`：5 到 60 秒的整数
- `session.wake_policy.vad_threshold`：可选，0 到 1，默认 0.5

超时后，服务器会发出 `session.paused`。当用户说话时，会触发 `session.resumed`。会话 ID 和历史记录会保留。OpenAI 警告称，短暂发言后的首次回复可能会较慢。待机期间请保持麦克风轨道处于活动状态。

待机功能适用于 GPT-Live-1 和 GPT-Live-1.1。

## **GPT-Live-1.1 的费用是多少？**

| 会话状态 | 每分钟价格 | 每小时价格 |
|---|---|---|
| 活动 | $0.05 | $3.00 |
| 待机（WebRTC，推理暂停） | $0.02 | $1.20 |

语音会话按持续时间计费。GPT-Live-1 模型页面称按秒计费。后端模型和工具使用单独计费。这一点很重要：繁重的后端成本可能高于语音层。

## **部署与可用性**

该模型仅提供 API。你通过将 `model` 设置为 `gpt-live-1.1` 来切换现有的 Live 会话。更改模型需要新建会话。

出站 SIP 呼叫已于 11 月 2 日覆盖所有组织，因此支持电话代理。GPT-Live-1 和 GPT-Live-1.1 有各自的并发会话限制。每个限制适用于所有推理区域。1.1 页面未公布层级数量。

## **GPT-Live-1.1 对比如何？**

| 功能 | GPT-Live-1.1 | GPT-Live-1 | GPT-Realtime-2.1 | Gemini 3.8 Live |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 开发者 | OpenAI | OpenAI | OpenAI |  |
| 参数 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 |
| 输入 | 音频、文本 | 音频、文本 | 文本、音频、图像 | 文本、图像、音频 |
| 输出 | 音频、文本 | 音频、文本 | 文本、音频 | 文本、音频 |
| 上下文 | 默认 128K（指南） | 默认 128K（指南） | 128K，最大输出 32K | 输入 131,072，输出 65,536 |
| 定价 | 活动 $0.05/分钟，待机 $0.02/分钟 | 活动 $0.05/分钟，待机 $0.02/分钟 | 每 1M 音频 token $32 / $64（输入/输出） | 基于 token（定价） |
| 空闲待机计费 | 是（WebRTC） | 是（WebRTC） | 未记录 | 未记录 |
| 推理 | 委托给后端模型 | 委托给后端模型 | 内置，可配置强度 | 交错推理 |
| 函数调用 | 是 | 是 | 是 | 是 |
| 结构化输出 | 否 | 否 | 未披露 | 否 |
| 已发布基准 | 1.1 无 | Full Duplex Bench 对比 GPT-Realtime-2.1 +30 分 | 该评估中的基线 | 未比较 |
| 许可证 / 权重 | 闭源，仅 API | 闭源，仅 API | 闭源，仅 API | 闭源，仅 API |

## **要点速览**

- GPT-Live-1.1 已在 API 中上线，名称为 `gpt-live-1.1`。
- 待机将空闲 WebRTC 计费从每分钟 $0.05 降至 $0.02。
- 空闲超时可配置为 5 到 60 秒。
- 口音、转录和任务改进为自报，未提供分数。
- 后端推理和工具与语音分钟数分开计费。

查看模型页面、Live 对话指南和公告。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**在此查看部署选项和规格。
